description: This file defines an authentication service (authService) supporting login, registration, and logout functionalities, with support for remote (Strapi) and local/mock modes.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts user login, supports remote and mock modes, normalizes user data.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user, supports remote and mock modes, normalizes user data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs a stateless logout, currently a no-op returning true.
